assumptions: Slurry at 62 wt% coal, 40 C, 40 bar absolute, outlet 1400 C.
Ash is neglected as the exam asks.
Examiner clarified: 80000 Nm3/h is the total of the single mixed inlet; use HYSYS native flow units.
Coal is modelled as pure solid carbon (modelling assumption, not implied by neglecting ash).
Nm3/h uses the HYSYS MolarFlow unit definition; no local 22.414 conversion is applied.
open_questions: The exam provides no oxygen feed. Holding 1400 C therefore means an externally heated model with a reported duty, not autothermal gasification.
Solid-carbon support in V15 Gibbs has not been verified beyond adding the component.
